bench.definition: A long seat where people can sit outdoors.

fountain.definition: A structure that sends water upward and lets it fall back down.

gazebo.definition: A small roofed structure in a park where people can rest.

bridge.definition: A structure built over water or a low place for people to cross.

statue.definition: A carved figure made to look like a person or animal.

trash-can.definition: A container that holds waste until it is removed.

lamp-post.definition: A tall post with a light that brightens paths after dark.

picnic-table.definition: A table with attached seats where people eat outdoors.

drinking-fountain.definition: A public device that supplies drinking water.

bike-rack.definition: A frame where bicycles can be locked safely.

pond.definition: A small area of still water surrounded by land.

stream.definition: A narrow flow of water moving through the ground.

hill.definition: An area of land that rises above the surrounding ground.

meadow.definition: An open area of grass, often with wild flowers.

shade-tree.definition: A tree planted to provide a cool place away from the sun.

flower-bed.definition: An area of soil where flowers are grown.

grass.definition: A green plant with narrow blades that covers the ground.

pebble.definition: A small smooth piece of stone found on the ground.

pinecone.definition: A brown seed that grows on some pine trees.

acorn.definition: A nut produced by an oak tree.

duck.definition: A water bird with a flat bill and webbed feet.

swan.definition: A large white water bird with a long curved neck.

squirrel.definition: A small animal with a bushy tail that gathers nuts.

pigeon.definition: A common bird with grey feathers that lives near people.

robin.definition: A small songbird with a red or orange breast.

frog.definition: A small animal that lives near water and catches insects.

turtle.definition: A slow-moving animal with a hard shell.

rabbit.definition: A small furry animal with long ears.

goose.definition: A large water bird with a long neck and webbed feet.

sparrow.definition: A small bird that often travels in groups.

walking.definition: Moving on foot at a steady pace for exercise or travel.

jogging.definition: Moving on foot faster than walking.

cycling.definition: Riding a bicycle for travel, exercise, or enjoyment.

picnic.definition: Eating a meal outdoors, often on a blanket or table.
picnic.arabicTranslation: نزهة (رحلة نزهة وتناول طعام في الهواء الطلق)

reading.definition: Looking at words in a book or other text.

sitting.definition: Resting on a seat with your body supported.

stretching.definition: Moving your body to loosen muscles and improve flexibility.

dog-walking.definition: Taking a dog outside while it walks beside you.

bird-watching.definition: Watching birds to identify and enjoy them.

kite.definition: A light frame covered with paper or cloth that flies on a string.

frisbee.definition: A flat flying disc thrown between people.

soccer-ball.definition: A round ball used for playing soccer.

jump-rope.definition: A toy with a rope that is swung under the feet.

skateboard.definition: A board with wheels used for riding while standing.

roller-skates.definition: Shoes with small wheels used for skating on hard ground.

badminton.definition: A game played by hitting a shuttlecock over a net.

tennis-ball.definition: A small ball used in tennis.

yoga-mat.definition: A soft mat used during yoga exercises.

bicycle.definition: A two-wheeled vehicle moved by pedalling.

park-map.definition: A sign or diagram showing paths and places in a park.

trail-sign.definition: A sign that shows the direction or name of a trail.

no-swimming-sign.definition: A sign telling people that swimming is not allowed.

keep-off-grass.definition: A sign asking people not to walk on the grass.

dog-allowed.definition: A sign showing that dogs may enter an area.

crosswalk.definition: A marked place where people cross a road safely.

speed-bump.definition: A raised strip across a road that makes vehicles slow down.

emergency-phone.definition: A telephone placed outdoors for urgent calls.

information-board.definition: A board displaying useful facts, rules, or directions.

recycling-bin.definition: A container used for items that can be processed again.

path.definition: A route made for walking through or between places.

oak-tree.definition: A large tree with lobed leaves and acorns.

shade.definition: Protection from sunlight provided by a tree or roof.

grass-lawn.definition: An area of ground covered evenly with short grass.

walk.definition: To move on foot at a regular pace.

jog.definition: To move on foot faster than walking.

cycle.definition: To ride a bicycle for travel, exercise, or enjoyment.

feed-ducks.definition: To give food to ducks in a pond or park.

fly-kite.definition: To send a kite into the air and control it with a string.

roller-skate.definition: To move on roller skates across a smooth surface.

sit-down.definition: To lower your body into a seated position.
